text:
Ravi: Heads up
 I issued a travel advance for Noah (ADV-2042) for a customer visit in Osaka. He just submitted the expense report and total reimbursable is lower than the advance by 12,400 JPY. Receipts are mix of card and cash. How do we handle the difference?
Tess: Quick check 
 what's our threshold for asking repayment vs payroll recovery?
Ravi: Our informal guideline has been $100 USD. This is about $85 if we use card FX, but cash receipts were converted using the travel day Oanda rate which pushes it to ~$92.
Noah: I can do a bank transfer but my credit card is linked to the travel card and the bank is slow. If payroll deduction is easiest, I can sign off here.
Ava: For audit we need an explicit ack in the expense system or in-thread confirmation: "I consent to payroll deduction for ADV-2042". Otherwise we request refund by bank.
expense-bot: Flag: ADV-2042 missing VAT invoice for taxi receipt at 2024-06-11. Policy: small taxi fares under 2,000 JPY can be reimbursed without VAT doc if noted.
Ravi: Noted. Noah can you please post the exact consent phrase in reply? Also add a short note on the taxi: "no vat, reimbursed at gross" so we can close.
Noah: I consent to payroll deduction for ADV-2042
Tess: OK finance 
 we'll do payroll adjustment for $92.00 USD. Please include accounting ref: GL-2042-COL and update the advance status to CLOSED.
Ava: When you submit the payroll file, use CSV columns: employee_id,amount,currency,payroll_code,reference. Payroll prefers payroll_code TRV-ADV-DEDUCT.
Ravi: Small policy ask: can we add a line clarifying that cash receipts use Oanda daily rate and card FX uses processor rate, to reduce back-and-forth? I'll draft and post to #policy-drafts.
Tess: +1 that will save time.
expense-bot: Reminder: advances older than 60 days without closure will trigger manager escalation.
Ravi: Thanks all, I
 marking this thread resolved once Ava confirms the payroll file has been uploaded.
Ava: Uploaded to payroll bucket, file name PAY-2024-06-18-adv-deductions.csv. Closing now :white_check_mark:
